description: Hong Kong stock market snapshot — closing levels and daily change for the whole Hang Seng index family: the Hang Seng Index (恒生指数, HSI), Hang Seng China Enterprises Index (恒生中国企业指数, HSCEI, the H-share benchmark), Hang Seng TECH Index (恒生科技指数, HSTECH), Hang Seng China-Affiliated Corporations Index (恒生香港中资企业指数, HSCCI, red chips), and the HSI Volatility Index (恒指波幅指数, VHSI). Answers 'Hang Seng index today', 'how did Hong Kong stocks close', '恒生指数最新收盘点位和涨跌幅', '恒生科技指数', 'HSCEI level', 'Hong Kong market close'. Each index returns level, change, change %, open, day high/low and 52-week high/low. Source: Sina (keyless).
